Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation.
The recorded demand forecast for part:340010 changed by +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).
Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 per price unit (cost:340010).
Your recorded on-time delivery rate is 79.5 % (sc:70410@2026Q3).

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation and would like an agreement that covers our full need.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message, which we have processed.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €33.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
For the record:
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you.
A shorter Lieferzeit means overtime; that is priced in.
The contract term is reflected in the price.
Your offer is far below any calculation we can make.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
These are our standard conditions for this product.
Please address any further questions in writing to this office.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
